cells.gaps: No count of decisions or sanctions for a year ending on or after 2024-09-30 has been found; the only count (NGA-065) covers about a year to 2024-06-11, and NGA-081 counts registrations, not decisions. The Meta Final Order was set aside by consent judgment on 2025-11-03 (NGA-078), and the Amendment Bill 2026 (NGA-037) is only tabled.
cells.note: In force with GAID 2025 issued and decisions on named controllers inside 36 months (Multichoice fine 2025-07-06, Stanbic judgment 2026-07-29), so stage 4. Stage 5 needs a count for a period ending after 2024-09-30, and the newest count ended 2024-06-11. I read NGA-025, NGA-030 and NGA-035 (Harunna v. NDPC, no named controller sanctioned) as activity, not applied; they do not set the stage. NGA-002 (suit dismissed once the NDPC order fell) is a judgment on a named controller, but the stage does not rest on it. Reassessed 2026-10-27 on NGA-078, which dates the Meta settlement inside the twelve months: it confirms `regressing` and moves nothing.
